response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — key requirements for the role. His DLang and Node.js background shows systems programming aptitude, but the absence of proven expertise in routing tile generation, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency geospatial data processing raises significant gaps.
strengths: Demonstrated geospatial project experience via open-source GISCollective
Strong systems programming background with DLang and low-latency systems
Proven ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No demonstrated experience with C++ or Rust in commercial routing/navigation systems
Lacks evidence of building routing tile pipelines or handling map data optimization at scale
Minimal exposure to distributed systems concepts like fault tolerance or service discovery in context
